2608.10209.title: Evaluation-Conditioned Training: Teaching Models to Generalize to Stronger Oversight Regimes
2608.10209.paper_summary: Feedback signals used to train Large Language Models (LLMs) are the primary driver of their behavior and our main lever for instilling alignment with human values and objectives. However, a key limitation of current post-training methods is the inability of human annotators and automated reward functions to faithfully capture the feedback we would like to give. We introduce Evaluation-Conditioned Training (ECT), a post-training framework that uses natural language to condition each training sample on the fidelity of the feedback we provide and then elicits the desired behavior by conditioning the LLM on a high-fidelity monitor in deployment. ECT is aimed at improving performance under imperfect feedback and works as an add-on to existing algorithms such as SFT and PPO. We first provide a conceptual framework for ECT and discuss its potential to address persistent sources of reward mis-specification. Then we motivate ECT in the context of the eliciting latent knowledge (ELK) problem. Finally, we evaluate ECT on two proof-of-concept experiments: increasing even-handedness in news article generation and reducing sycophancy on an arithmetic task. In each setting, we utilize imperfect feedback, rewarding bias and agreement with the user, respectively. In both settings, ECT improves the targeted behavior relative to direct training.
2608.10209.paper_summary_zh: 反饋信號用於訓練大型語言模型（LLMs），是其行為的主要驅動力，也是我們灌輸與人類價值觀和目標一致性的主要杠杆。<lb/>然而，目前後訓練方法的一個關鍵限制是人類標註者和自動獎勵函數無法真實捕捉我們希望給予的反饋。<lb/>我們引入了評估條件訓練（ECT），這是一種後訓練框架，利用自然語言將每個訓練樣本的反饋真實性進行條件化，然後通過在部署中將LLM條件化於高真實性的監控器來引出期望的行為。<lb/>ECT旨在改善在不完美反饋下的表現，並作為現有算法（如SFT和PPO）的附加功能。<lb/>我們首先提供ECT的概念框架，並討論其解決持續獎勵錯誤規範來源的潛力。<lb/>然後，我們在引出潛在知識（ELK）問題的背景下激勵ECT。<lb/>最後，我們在兩個概念驗證實驗中評估ECT：在新聞文章生成中提高公正性，並在算術任務中減少拍馬屁行為。<lb/>在每個環境中，我們利用不完美的反饋，分別獎勵偏見和與用戶的一致性。<lb/>在這兩種環境中，ECT相對於直接訓練改善了目標行為。
